answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, as a result paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in quill, verified in juniper, and saffron names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 32 submissions per epoch. A 239 account operation therefore ties up 40 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
